purpose: Research-stage evidence and activation gate inventory; not investment or regulatory clearance

gate_definitions.customer: Product-specific demand or validated customer brief
gate_definitions.ingredient: Exact product ingredient intended use and supplier safety evidence
gate_definitions.manufacturing: Suitable production process and qualified vendor
gate_definitions.economics: Full landed-unit costs and working capital, not tolling alone
gate_definitions.legal: Entity, IP, insurance and product-specific regulatory review

ventures.name: Poolside Margaritas
ventures.blocker: Commercial recipe, tequila quote, final technical specifications, brand/entity decisions and Phase I funding approval.
ventures.next: Log remaining formulator and tequila-supply responses; complete actual landed COGS and R&D budget.
ventures.proof: Islamorada, Right Coast and Deibel written correspondence; no production commitment.

ventures.name: Cocoa Shell Tea
ventures.blocker: Suitable edible-use cocoa-shell ingredient and independent review of contaminant, microbiology and regulatory records.
ventures.next: Receive supplier documents and qualify a second food-grade source.
ventures.proof: Supplier inquiry sent; no written supplier qualification yet.

ventures.name: Sparkling Tea Soda
ventures.blocker: Flavor validation, product formulation, process/shelf-life requirements and real manufacturing prices.
ventures.next: Benchmark competitors and design customer preference study.
ventures.proof: Three conceptual product briefs; no testing completed.

ventures.name: Zero-Proof Social Drinks
ventures.blocker: Exact ingredients, compliant claims, consumer tasting protocol and manufacturer feasibility.
ventures.next: Compare social-drink alternatives and refine conventional-ingredient concepts.
ventures.proof: Two conceptual briefs; functional actives not cleared.

ventures.name: Hemp Foods: Seasoning & Chips
ventures.blocker: Ingredient-specific conventional-food eligibility; CBD-added food remains federally constrained.
ventures.next: Qualify hemp hearts/protein for seasoning and tortilla-style chip hypotheses; document manufacturer and price feasibility.
ventures.proof: FDA ingredient GRAS notices identified, including chips as an intended use for specified hulled hemp seed; no finished product formula or clearance.

ventures.name: Botanical Smoke Blends
ventures.blocker: Ingredient-specific inhalation-toxicology evidence and appropriate regulatory classification.
ventures.next: Continue literature and compliance screening; no human testing or manufacturing.

ventures.name: Hemp Flower / CBD Flower Tea
ventures.blocker: Lawful classification of hemp-flower as a food/ingestible product, finished-infusion safety and cannabinoid exposures.
ventures.next: Compare conventional herbal-tea vs state-regulated hemp-product vs licensed medical-market routes; seek legal review before procurement.
ventures.proof: Concept only; no GRAS finding or food authorization for the flower.

ventures.name: Regenerative Hemp Biorefinery
ventures.stage: Circular campus and carbon materials feasibility
ventures.blocker: No measured hemp yields, soil-grade biochar assays, market-ready graphene characterization, verified mass/energy/LCA or permitted plant engineering.
ventures.next: Compare fiber and biochar product buyers; map feedstock allocation, qualified pyrolysis partners and third-party carbon-material characterization.
ventures.proof: Modular architecture and independent research references; no operating pilot or verified hemp graphene product.
